name: show_preview
summary: Draw wire boxes for a planned layout on the player's screen only: place_structure's dry run of the placements (footprint, render box, port cells), plus cells and boxes. Nothing in the world changes.

help.text: Takes place_structure's placement fields. Footprint green (red with a problem), render box white, port joining cells cyan (red when blocked); cells (up to 512, yellow 0.5 m cubes, such as a planned route) and boxes [{min, max, color}] (up to 64). seconds default 30, max 300; a new call clears the last unless keep; clear only removes. xray draws through walls and terrain. Returns shown, cleared, seconds, dry_run, notes, drawn_on and view.

allow_door_keepout.description: As place_structure: a piece in a door keep-out is a warning (see doors).

cells.description: Yellow 0.5 m cubes at these points, up to 512.

min.description: One corner, [x, y, z] in metres.

color.description: red, green, white, cyan or yellow.

seconds.description: How long to show; default 30, max 300.

keep.description: true: keep what earlier calls drew. Default false.

xray.description: Draw through walls, frames and terrain. Default false.
